title: Anti-Spoofing and Audio Watermarking — Detection, Provenance, and Attacks

questions.question: With n_fft=64, how many values does magnitude_spectrum return?
questions.explanation: The function allocates n_fft//2 + 1 values, so a 64-point transform returns 33 nonnegative-frequency bins.

questions.question: What does toy_detector_score measure from the spectrum?
options: The number of zero crossings in the waveform
The average sign of all time-domain samples
The fraction of total magnitude in the upper half of the bins
questions.explanation: toy_detector_score sums spectrum[len(spec)//2:] and divides by the total spectrum magnitude.

questions.question: For an audio array of length 4,096 and a 16-bit payload, at which sample index is zero-based payload bit 5 embedded?
questions.explanation: The embed step is 4096//16=256, and bit 5 uses index 5*256=1,280.

questions.question: In the toy EER sweep, which fake samples count toward the false-accept rate at threshold t?
options: Fake scores s where s < t
Fake scores s where s >= t
Real scores s where s >= t
Real scores s where s < t
questions.explanation: The code computes far as the fraction of diff (fake) scores satisfying s >= t.

questions.question: How does toy_watermark_detect recover each payload bit?
options: It compares the whole clip with the original clean waveform
It recomputes the high-band spectral ratio and thresholds it at 0.5
It checks the sign of the sample at the same evenly spaced index used during embedding
It counts how many codebook centroids occur in the clip
questions.explanation: Detection uses step=len(audio)//n_bits and emits 1 when audio[idx] > 0, otherwise 0.

questions.question: Which distinction is correct for the two defenses shown in this lesson?
options: Watermarking detects every synthetic clip without a detector model
Anti-spoofing embeds ownership bits; watermarking estimates EER
They are identical methods with different names
Anti-spoofing classifies suspicious audio; watermarking carries a provenance signal
questions.explanation: The spectral score is a synthetic-audio detector, while the watermark modifies and later reads a payload from audio.
